uniqueness_dots.verdict: NO DRIFT - unique against all 696 registered rasters
uniqueness_dots.verdict_basis: max chance-corrected lift 1.999, and that is on a 244-dot registry raster with raw overlap 0.0012. The literal >0.70 rule is tripped by 20 of 696 rasters, but those are dense continuous surfaces: the maximum lift among them is 1.068 (272,853-dot raster covering 69.6% of the footprint within 3 px) and several have lift exactly 1.000 because they are positive over all 5,167,373 footprint pixels, so any dot pattern trips the literal rule against them.
